EVIDENCE: V1 static industry resonance was non-monotonic; V1 panel and CY-006 PIT-B cache are available.
OLD_HYPOTHESIS: Static industry membership is a sufficient proxy for the stocks traded by the same theme capital.
WHY_INADEQUATE: V1 sector breadth high-minus-low was unstable across 2020-2023.
NEW_HYPOTHESIS: Trailing 20-session return co-movement identifies a more economically relevant peer basket.
ECONOMIC_SEQUENCE: Leadership -> frozen dynamic co-movement peers -> peer pressure -> leader resilience.
MATERIAL_CHANGE: Replace static industry-only peer representation with one fixed top-20 trailing-correlation representation.
BASELINE: PIT static industry peers and no peer-pressure event.
EXPECTED: Dynamic peer leader/basket synchrony and pressure coverage exceed static industry baseline.
FALSIFIER: Dynamic peer quality is not materially better than static industry or has insufficient causal coverage.

EVIDENCE: Predeclared pressure episode uses first 3-session peer drawdown at or below -1.0 prior-information sigma within 15 sessions.
OLD_HYPOTHESIS: A single pressure day is sufficient to measure resilience.
WHY_INADEQUATE: V1 pressure was a one-day state and did not represent a sustained common selling episode.
NEW_HYPOTHESIS: A leader that resists its frozen peer basket through a fixed 3-session pressure window has abnormal resilience.
ECONOMIC_SEQUENCE: Frozen peer basket -> first pressure episode -> 3-session simple relative resilience and expected-move residual -> later outcome.
MATERIAL_CHANGE: Use first occurrence only; estimate pressure distribution from prior 120 three-session observations and betas from prior 60 daily observations.
BASELINE: Pressure events with weak resilience and all no-pressure events retained.
EXPECTED: Natural resilience quintiles show a broad, stable, non-decreasing future relationship.
FALSIFIER: No directional quintile relation, unstable annual signs, or residual information disappears under fixed controls.

EVIDENCE: A common landmark is required because earlier repair classification starts at different confirmation times.
OLD_HYPOTHESIS: Full repair after pressure is the useful transition state.
WHY_INADEQUATE: V1 G3 did not improve over G2 and its outcome anchor was not a common pressure landmark.
NEW_HYPOTHESIS: Early relative re-acceleration visible by a common P+4 landmark may precede full repair.
ECONOMIC_SEQUENCE: Pressure P..P+2 -> fixed landmark L=P+4 -> early relative re-acceleration -> outcome from L+1.
MATERIAL_CHANGE: Classify R0/R1/R2 only with information through L; all outcomes start after L; no post-landmark repair backfill.
EXPECTED: G3 exceeds G2 without requiring full repair; if not, close re-acceleration and repair.
FALSIFIER: G3 does not exceed G2 or the relationship is concentrated/unstable.
